archimate:Outcome.name: Policy-makers and Researchers use Aggregated Trusted Data for Decisions
archimate:Outcome.documentation:
The "Policy-makers and Researchers use Aggregated Trusted Data for Decisions" capability is an evidence-based governance objective focused on providing high-level stakeholders with anonymized, validated, and consolidated healthcare datasets to guide system-wide strategies and medical studies.
Its purpose is to replace speculative choices with data-driven insights, ensuring that public health interventions, resource allocations, and clinical research projects are backed by reliable, real-world evidence.
Example: A national health ministry utilizes this capability by pulling five years of standardized, multi-hospital electronic records to identify rising diabetes trends and subsequently fund targeted preventative care clinics in the highest-risk regions.
